spell.zoltraak_cinematic.zoltraak.desc: Ordinary Offensive Magic (人類の魔法). Unleashes an ultra-realistic, hypersonic piercing photonic beam with devastating 10-block terminal shockwave and HDR bloom.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.corrupted_zoltr: Qual's original forbidden spell. Releases a superdense Event-Horizon void beam with electric magenta flares that pierces armor and withers life.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.zoltraak_barrag: Manifests a grand 24-circle celestial matrix, continuously unleashing rapid volleys of converging guided Zoltraak light lances at the target point.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.corrupted_barra: Manifests 24 dark singularity circles, continuously firing dark matter thorns that dissolve barriers and wither enemies.
item.zoltraak_cinematic.frieren_staff.de: Iconic staff of the ancient elven mage Frieren. Amplifies all Spell Power and grants +35% Zoltraak Spell Power.
item.zoltraak_cinematic.mirror_lotus_rin: Engraved with the mirror lotus flower. Symbolizes eternal devotion and grants +25% Zoltraak Spell Power.
item.zoltraak_cinematic.mana_concealment: Imbued with the ancient elven discipline of compressing mana aura. Grants +20% Zoltraak Resistance.
item.zoltraak_cinematic.ordinary_grimoir: Ancient scriptures deciphering the pinnacle of mankind's standard offensive magic. Focus for Ordinary Magic.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.defense.desc: Standard defensive magic of modern mages. Instantly deploys a hexagonal honeycomb barrier (directional aegis or 360-degree dome when sneaking) that protects the caster while allowing offensive spells to be cast simultaneously.
ui.zoltraak_cinematic.defense_not_in_spe: Defensive Magic is not inscribed in your equipped spellbook!
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.flight.desc: Mankind's reverse-engineered flight magic (人類の魔法). Grants free 3D omnidirectional flight while continuously consuming mana. Flying higher or faster causes mana consumption to skyrocket exponentially.
ui.zoltraak_cinematic.flight_exponential: §cWarning: Soaring high or sprinting burns mana exponentially!
item.zoltraak_cinematic.elder_sage_grimo: Ancient forbidden spellbook of Qual. Saturated with the pure calculus of Killing Magic (Zoltraak).
item.zoltraak_cinematic.horn_of_corrupti: A radiant seven-pointed prismatic crystal condensed from the ancient mana of the Elder Sage Qual. Used as a supreme catalyst for crafting mythic artifacts.
Singularity talisman torn from the Elder Sage. Grants massive Zoltraak power and rapid mana recovery.
message.zoltraak_cinematic.unsealing_sta: §c⚠ The ancient seal begins to crack! Frieren's runes turn blood-red! ⚠
